page_title: GET 3-1 MAL | Getafe v Mallorca 13/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.

89' What an opportunity! Sebastian Boselli (Getafe) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
86' Mario Martin (Getafe) has tested the patience of referee Juan Martinez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
84' The photographers scatter as a shot from the edge of the box by Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) blazes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
81' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Martinez had an easy-decision to make.
81' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Mallorca, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

80' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Davinchi (Getafe) was quite harsh and Juan Martinez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card. Mallorca have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
79' Substitution. Manu Morlanes makes his way off the pitch and Abdon Prats (Mallorca) comes on as his replacement.
79' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Mallorca, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

78' Juan Martinez shows a yellow card to Domingos Duarte (Getafe) for his blatant foul. Mallorca are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
76' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
75' Getafe take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
75' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Getafe will take a corner kick.
74' Caution goes to Pablo Torre (Mallorca).

72' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He creates some space for the shot, but blazes it high over the crossbar. Very bad attempt. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
71' Djene has picked up an injury and is replaced by Sebastian Boselli (Getafe).
66' Martin Demichelis has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) replacing Sergi Darder.
66' It will be a substitution. Takuma Asano (Mallorca) is ready to enter the pitch as Jan Virgili walks off.

65' 3 - 1 Perfectly taken free kick! Pablo Torre sends the ball in, Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) manages to jump highest near the penalty spot and plants a cracking header low inside the left post. It's 3:1.
64' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to substitute Allan Nyom and he is replaced by Davinchi (Getafe).
64' It looks like Mario Martin (Getafe) saw red with that tackle. Juan Martinez won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Mallorca.

63' 3 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Luis Milla flights the free kick into the box, where Zaid Romero (Getafe) peels off his marker and heads straight inside the upright from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 3:0.
62' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Juan Martinez blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Getafe.
60' Mario Martin (Getafe) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.

58' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Mallorca are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
53' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) was too forceful with his tackle and Juan Martinez interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
50' The attendance for today's match is 7238.
48' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
46' Martin Demichelis makes a half-time substitution. Pablo Torre (Mallorca) comes on in place of Zito Luvumbo.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+5' The corner is swung in but Getafe can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+4' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Juan Martinez no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick to Getafe.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
43' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) gets booked.
43' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
41' 2 - 0 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Martin Satriano (Getafe), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 2:0.
40' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) commits a foul and Juan Martinez immediately signals a free kick.
38' Wonderful movement by Mallorca. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

37' The ball rebounds out to Allan Nyom (Getafe) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
37' Getafe failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
34' Mallorca couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as David Soria (Getafe) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
31' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and can count himself very lucky that the referee didn't issue a red card.
29' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) rises high to connect with a cross from the corner kick, but his powerful header from near the penalty spot crashes against the crossbar!
29' Mallorca force a corner. They send men into the box.
26' Juan Martinez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Zaid Romero (Getafe) and blew his whistle.

24' Getafe slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
22' Mario Martin (Getafe) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
20' The Mallorca players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
17' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) makes a strong challenge and Juan Martinez blows for a foul.

16' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
16' It will be a corner kick for Mallorca.
14' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Allan Nyom plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Martin Satriano (Getafe). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 1:0.
11' Mallorca enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
9' An attempted cross from Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) is cleared.
6' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Mallorca, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
5' Juan Martinez blows for a foul after Djene (Getafe) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick is awarded to Mallorca.
2' Luis Orejuela (Mallorca) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
2' Mallorca force their opponents to concede a corner.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Mallorca will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Juan Martinez.
